_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — nothing in Smart AI Bridge loads this file. It documents how to fill in the fields that src/config/backends.json ships without: a pinned model, an API key, a custom endpoint, a disabled lane, and operator-declared model capabilities. Copy the fragment you need into backends.json.
description: Worked examples for backends.json fields — not a live config

gemini_pinned_example._comment: Pin an explicit model id instead of relying on auto-selection. config.model, when set, ALWAYS wins over discovery — this is how you override the auto-selected choice.
gemini_pinned_example.description: Google Gemini, pinned to a specific model

groq_via_proxy_example._comment: Point a cloud-shaped lane at a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible proxy instead of the public endpoint, by setting config.url.
groq_via_proxy_example.description: Groq lane routed through a local proxy

nvidia_glm_disabled_example._comment: Disable a lane entirely with enabled:false — it is skipped at boot, never health-checked, and never routed to.

openai_apikey_literal_example._comment: config.apiKey accepts a literal value too, though "$ENV_VAR_NAME" (resolved from process.env) keeps secrets out of this file, which is why every other example above uses it.
openai_apikey_literal_example.description: OpenAI lane with an inline key placeholder

local_declared_capabilities_example._comment: Declare what the model on this lane can actually do. SAB derives NOTHING from a model's name: a server reports structural facts only (chat template caps, modalities, context size) and never a semantic capability, so the operator is the only trustworthy source for 'this one is code-specialized' or 'this one is a deep reasoner'. Declared capabilities WIN over anything the server reports; declare nothing and the lane still routes, on server-reported structure plus a general default.

config._comment_capabilities: Valid values: deep_reasoning, fast_generation, large_context, code_specialized, security_focus, documentation, fast_routing, vision, tool_use, general. Unknown strings are ignored.
config._comment_modelCapabilities: Optional, for a router serving several models at once: declare capabilities per EXACT model id as your server reports it in /v1/models. Matched exactly, never by pattern, so a model you do not list here simply falls back to config.capabilities.
